title: Voice, Speech & Sound Production Factory
objective: Provide deterministic local-first voice, speech and sound production preparation over completed PCA audio-authoring foundations while preserving AAI audio semantics/playback authority, DWC constructed-language pronunciation authority, ARI resource/provenance/rights authority and canonical speaker/narrative/runtime owner domains, and keeping generated media distinct from canonical speech intent, pronunciation truth, live playback or publication.

scope.purpose: Prepare local-first, provider-replaceable voice, speech and sound production candidates over existing audio-authoring and owner references without replacing AAI, DWC-SPEECH, ARI or canonical speaker/narrative/runtime authority.
scope.completion_gate: Representative authorized PCA-07 authoring, AAI, DWC-SPEECH, speaker-owner and ARI inputs can deterministically prepare inspectable voice/speech/sound candidate-production plans with stable provenance and fail-closed invalid owner/reference/rights/adapter states while preserving AAI/DWC/ARI/canonical owner authority and remaining useful with optional external synthesis/audio providers disabled.

selection_boundaries: PCA-01..07 remain completed foundations and were composed rather than reimplemented or weakened.
PCA-07 remains interactive-audio authoring authority; PCA-08 consumed prepared authoring plans and did not replace AAI semantics or create a parallel audio runtime.
AAI retains audio source/asset identities, cue/soundscape semantics and AAI-04 playback authority; PCA-08 produced candidate production/QC/registration plans only and performed no playback.
DWC-SPEECH retains constructed-language exact-pronunciation authority; PCA-08 consumed validated DWC references only and performed no pronunciation inference, synthesis or mutation.
CNI-05 retains structured dialogue/speaker authority; PCA-08 validated dialogue/node/speaker/text projections and performed no dialogue or speaker mutation.
ARI-02/ARI-03/ARI-11 retain resource identity, derivative lineage and rights/use authority; PCA-08 required transform rights and emitted candidate registration references only.

Optional provider adapters remained replaceable; PCA-08 performed no credential access, network/provider execution, paid-service operation, procurement, public upload, publication, release or canonical mutation.

ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.json schema 1.0.3 was reconsulted after exact-tree PCA-08 publication. PCA-08 now satisfies the PCA-08 prerequisite in MSAS, but MSAS still requires PCA-15 and FOUR_LANE_RELEASE_BARRIER; MCS and MCCS likewise remain blocked by PCA-15 and the barrier, and PCA-08 unlocks no interstitial rotation/studio start. PCA-09 is therefore the lawful next selected PCA item.
PCA-09 is selected_not_started only; no branch or implementation authority exists until a later owner Continue governed-starts it. PCA-10+, MSAS, MCCS, SMB-08 and downstream work remain unauthorized.
next_action: PCA-08 is closed. PCA-09 is selected_not_started after fresh ROADMAP_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH reconciliation and requires a later owner Continue before governed start.
